usageNotes: Use this to open a terminal (shell) session to a PVE node managed by PDM. The call returns a short-lived VNC/WebSocket ticket that must be used immediately to upgrade an HTTP connection to a terminal websocket — it is not an async job and returns no UPID. Requires the Sys.Console privilege on the target remote+node combination, so API tokens must be scoped accordingly.

examples.summary: Open a terminal session to node 'pve1' on remote 'hetzner-de'

tips: The returned port is always 0 — use the ticket value directly for the WebSocket handshake; no separate port binding is needed.
Tickets are single-use and short-lived; consume the ticket immediately after receiving it.
The node value accepts 'localhost' to target the PDM host's local PVE instance.
